phrases.latin: Theodōrus, animī pendēns, quaesīvit: «Ut tē jūvit crustum, ave?»
phrases.english: Theo, in suspense, asked, “How did you like the pie, Grandpa?”

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 108, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
